cost: Bounded native fixtures compose only reached public API costs; external acquisition is excluded.
description: Seven supplied-input pragmatic joins with nine typed source-bound views.
forward: Preserve field/dictionary identities, prefix-available predecessor feedback, voice-sensitive agreement and present-class score denominators.
inverse: Universe U consists of tagged valid aligned rows, slot dictionaries with unique values, finite trained classifiers, unique valid schedules, closed labels and supported agreement tables. An inner source-derived approximation to U minus R excludes: a known encoded slot becoming UNSEEN after serialize/reindex; a predicted in-range field tuple changing under canonical TSV parse; feedback from an unvisited predecessor; cross-source predecessor links; narrator-tree replacement of character speech form; altered accuracy denominator or inclusion of absent classes in the macro-F1 mean. The finite checks witness these constraints only for their fixtures; malformed dictionaries/models and arbitrary TSV means are outside U.

For an observed class tuple retain all full-width rows, dictionaries and fitted models that predict that tuple under the supplied schedule. Numeric feature IDs fix values only within a particular dictionary; UNSEEN is a fiber of all unrecorded strings. Schedule outputs retain all compatible prior predictions and fallback branches, not unique text. Agreement's output retains all compatible original labels/witness/tree inputs and every omitted means string. Neither successful serialization nor an equal class tuple reconstructs training history, raw spelling, parse trees or semantic intent. These are converse relations, not implemented universal searches.
limitations: Bounded native evidence and repeated partial syntax are recorded; no general proof is inferred.
eval.rs and data.rs are explicit unregistered dependencies; no live parser, teacher, witness, corpus, GPU or CLI pipeline is executed.
Transport equivalence and bounded test observers do not establish general model accuracy or unique antecedents.
state: Valid aligned full-width rows, built/reindexed dictionaries, closed classes, unique supplied schedules and canonical TSV labels.
